# Draft:Kingsley K. Ekwe

Dr. Kingsley Ekwe is a Nigerian consultant orthopaedic and trauma surgeon, currently serving as an Executive Director and Head of Surgery at Cedarcrest Hospitals.
Early Life and Education
Dr. Ekwe graduated from the University of Jos in 2000 with a medical degree. He underwent postgraduate training in various hospitals within Nigeria and abroad. In 2009, he was awarded the fellowship of the West African College of Surgeons.
Career
Dr. Ekwe previously worked as a consultant orthopaedic and trauma surgeon at the National Hospital Abuja before joining Cedarcrest Hospitals. At Cedarcrest, he has been instrumental in advancing orthopaedic and trauma care, with a focus on arthroplasty, general orthopaedics, and orthopaedic trauma.
Specialization and Contributions
With over a decade of experience in general and subspecialty orthopaedics, Dr. Ekwe has undergone extensive training and exposure in orthopaedic surgery worldwide. His expertise includes trauma care with minimal scarring and excellent patient outcomes. His contributions to the field have reinforced best practices in orthopaedic trauma and surgical procedures in Nigeria.
